description: The NMSLO and the Mescalero Apache Tribe will be hosting the first two in a series of public meetings in the coming weeks to hear any questions, concerns, or feedback you may have about the proposed land exchange between the two entities. The meetings can be attended in-person or online via Zoom.
title: Community Meetings Scheduled for Proposed Land Exchange — Doreen Ybarra Gallegos - NM State Representative District 52
